course.title: Engineering Construction Management

content.value: An 132 KVA distribution transformer has 550 turns on the primary and 110 turns on the secondary winding. The primary is connected to 11 KV, 50 Hz supply. Find the full load primary and secondary current, the value of the secondary EMF and the maximum value of flux in the core.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2018
